blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)的安全调整主要在培训后进行,而最近的工作也已开始将安全数据纳入培训前的工作。 然而,如果以后的培训不再包括安全数据,安全就会退化,安全方面的进步往往以一般能力为代价。 这种紧张关系表明,不应将安全和一般推理视为单独的训练目标。 相反,我们认为安全是一种LLM能力,可以通过与一般任务共享的推理结构来学习。 两者都要求模型了解意图或任务目标,应用相关知识和关于潜在后果的理由。 我们引入了安全中期培训,这是从培训前到培训后的一个阶段,通过这一共同结构共同发展安全和一般推理。 鉴于安全和实用提示,该基本模型产生结构化的文件和推理痕迹,然后用于中期培训。 相较于Qune3-1.7B,4B和8B基型,安全中训将平均攻击成功率(ASR)降低72%至81%,同时也提高了一般能力. 通过随后的培训,这些好处依然存在。 在通用的SFT之后,中训练型基本保持了安全性,实现了低于基线的ASR而不牺牲一般能力. 它们也保留了普通专用GRPO的安全,没有安全奖赏,而随后的RL在从中培训模式初始化时,达到了更好的安全用途前沿. 这些结果表明,在共同的中培训阶段学习安全和一般推理可以减少安全效用的取舍,并使安全对随后的培训更加有力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLM safety has become a central part of model development ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) , but most safety alignment is still applied after pre-training. A base model is first trained for general capability, and safety behavior is later added through supervised fine-tuning ( Bianchi et al., 2024 ) , preference learning ( Bai et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) , or related alignment methods. This post-training paradigm has improved refusal behavior on many benchmarks. In addition, recent work incorporates safety data into pre-training ( Maini et al., 2025 ) or uses alignment-oriented documents during mid-training ( Korbak et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , allowing models to learn about safe behavior at earlier stages of training.
blocks.zh: LLM安全已经成为模型开发的核心部分(Sun等人,2024年;姚等人,2024年),但大多数安全配对在预训后仍然应用. 基础模型首先为一般能力培训,后来通过监督微调(Bianchi等人,2024年),偏好学习(Bai等人,2022年;Rafailov等人,2023年;Shao等人,2024年),或相关对齐方法,添加安全行为. 这种训练后模式在许多基准上改善了拒绝行为. 此外,最近的工作将安全数据纳入培训前(Maini等人,2025年),或在中期培训期间使用面向协调的文件(Korbak等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年),使模型能够在培训的早期阶段了解安全行为。

blocks.en: However, safety learned during one stage can decline during subsequent training. The final safety behavior can become highly sensitive to the composition of the SFT data. If later SFT contains little or no safety data, the model may quickly lose safety even when the training data is intended to improve general capability ( Qi et al., 2023 ) . This is especially relevant when adapting models to new tasks, where training data often focuses on the task itself. At the same time, safety training can create a trade-off between safety and general capability ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . The base model already has reasoning patterns learned during pre-training, while safety fine-tuning often focuses on refusal behavior. As a result, improving refusal behavior can also interfere with general reasoning and instruction following. Both challenges point to the importance of how safety is connected to the model’s general capabilities during training.
blocks.zh: 然而,在一个阶段学到的安全知识在随后的培训中可能会下降。 最终的安全行为可以变得对SFT数据的组成高度敏感. 如果后来的SFT包含很少或没有安全数据,即使培训数据意在提高一般能力,该模型也可能很快失去安全(Qi等人,2023年). 在使模型适应新任务时,这一点特别相关,因为培训数据往往侧重于任务本身。 同时,安全培训可以在安全能力与一般能力之间形成权衡(Huang等人,2025年)。 基础模型已经具备了在预训期间学到的推理模式,而安全微调往往侧重于拒绝行为. 因此,改进拒绝行为也会干扰一般推理和随后的指示。 这两项挑战都表明,在培训期间,安全如何与模型的一般能力相联系。

(a) Mid-training moves all Qwen3 and Llama3.2 models toward higher safety and utility. (b) As safety data is reduced during SFT, base models lose safety, while mid-trained models remain stable.

blocks.en: We take the view that safety should be learned as a foundational capability of LLMs . Safe responses depend on abilities that are also central to general reasoning. Specifically, the model needs to understand the user’s intent or task goal, apply relevant knowledge and constraints, and reason about the possible consequences of an answer. These abilities define a shared reasoning structure through which safety and general capability can be learned together. For example, helping a user recover an account requires knowledge of authentication and attention to whether the proposed steps preserve the account owner’s control. The same knowledge helps the model recognize when a request would give someone unauthorized access. Learning to reason about such requests therefore connects safe behavior with the knowledge and reasoning abilities used to provide useful assistance.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,安全应作为法学硕士的基础能力来学习。 安全对策取决于对一般推理也至关重要的能力。 具体来说,模型需要了解用户的意图或任务目标,应用相关的知识和限制,以及回答可能的后果的理由。 这些能力界定了一个共同的推理结构,通过这个结构可以共同学习安全和一般能力。 例如,帮助用户收回账户需要了解认证,并注意拟议步骤是否保持账户所有人的控制。 同样的知识有助于模型识别何时请求会给予某人未经授权的访问. 因此,了解这些请求的理由,将安全行为与用来提供有用协助的知识和推理能力联系起来。

blocks.en: To learn this shared reasoning structure, we introduce safety mid-training , a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning. Mid-training continues the base model’s capability learning before instruction tuning or preference optimization ( OLMo et al., 2024 ; Lambert et al., 2024 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . It provides an opportunity to train on the knowledge and reasoning behind safe responses while learning from general tasks in the same stage. We therefore organize safety and utility examples in a common format and train the base model on them together. In this way, the model learns to apply its existing knowledge to safe behavior through the reasoning structure it also uses for general tasks. This connection provides a way to improve safety while preserving general capability, and gives later SFT and RL a model that has already learned to use these abilities for safety.
blocks.zh: 为了了解这种共同的推理结构,我们引入了安全中期训练,这是从培训前到培训后的一个阶段,共同发展安全和一般推理。 中级培训在教学调整或优化之前继续基本模式的能力学习(OLMo等人,2024年;Lambert等人,2024年;Grattafiori等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年)。 它提供了一个机会,在从同一阶段的一般任务中学习的同时,对安全对策背后的知识和推理进行培训。 因此,我们以共同格式组织安全和效用范例,并共同培训这些范例的基础模型。 这样,模型通过它也用于一般任务的推理结构,学习将它现有的知识应用于安全行为. 这种连接提供了一种在保持一般能力的同时提高安全性的方法,并给后来的SFT和RL提供了一种已经学会将这些能力用于安全性的模型.

blocks.en: Based on this view, we construct safety mid-training data with a self-generation pipeline ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) , as described in Figure 2 . We start from existing safety and utility prompts. For each prompt, the base model generates a structured document that organizes the information needed for the response. It also generates a reasoning trace that connects this information to a complete answer. The generated traces are filtered by a judge model for faithfulness, coherence, and consistency with the reference answer and safety label. The accepted documents and reasoning traces form a corpus for training safety and general capability together. Using the base model itself to generate this data makes the construction process practical without requiring a larger model as the generator.
blocks.zh: 根据这一观点,我们用自发电管道构建安全培训中期数据(Agarwal 等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2026年;Shenfeld等人,2026年)。 我们从现有的安全和公用事业提示开始。 对于每个提示,基模型生成一个结构化的文档,组织响应所需的信息. 它还产生推理追踪,将这些信息与完整的答案联系起来. 生成的痕迹通过法官模型过滤,以显示忠诚、一致性和与参考答案和安全标签的一致性。 公认的文件和推理痕迹构成一个培训安全和一般能力的工具。 利用基模型本身生成这种数据,使构造过程切实可行,而不需要更大的模型作为生成器.

blocks.en: We evaluate safety mid-training on Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, and Llama3.2-1B, 3B base models, using a pool of 185K prompts and about 200M mid-training tokens. Without any SFT, safety mid-training reduces average ASR on malicious requests by 68% to 86% relative to the base models, while also improving utility (Tables 1 and 5 ). After SFT, our models achieve lower average ASR than the post-training-only, Safety Pretraining, and Alignment Pretraining baselines across all three SFT data mixtures, while maintaining strong general capability (Table 2 ). These results show that safety mid-training improves safety before and after instruction tuning and alleviates the safety-utility trade-off.
blocks.zh: 我们利用185K导电符和约200M的中试符,对Qune3–1.7B,4B,8B,以及Llama3.2–1B,3B基型进行安全中试评价. 没有任何SFT, 安全中培训将恶意请求的平均ASR比基本模型减少68%至86%,同时提高效用(表1和表5)。 在SFT之后,我们的模型实现的平均ASR低于只培训后的Safety Pretraining,以及所有三种SFT数据混合物的对齐Pretrain基线,同时保持强大的一般能力(表2)。 这些结果表明,安全培训中期可提高教学前后的安全性,缓解安全实用性权衡。

blocks.en: More importantly, the safety gains remain when subsequent training uses only general data. Under general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines while maintaining general capability (Figure 1 (b) and Table 2 ). We also evaluate GRPO and find that safety-midtrained models hold a clear advantage over base models throughout training. When GRPO uses only general prompts, with no safety data or safety rewards, mid-trained models retain much of their safety, whereas the base models lose substantially more safety compared with training that includes safety data and rewards. In addition, even after GRPO has fully converged, the advantage of mid-training persists, showing that it raises the ceiling that later RL can reach for both safety and general capability. Together, the SFT and GRPO results show that safety learned through shared reasoning can remain effective as the model continues to learn from general tasks.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,当随后的培训仅使用一般数据时,安全方面的成果依然存在。 在一般的SFT下,中训练型基本上保持了安全,实现了低于基线的ASR,同时保持了一般能力(图1(b)和表2)。 我们还评估了GRPO,发现安全培训模式在整个培训过程中明显比基本模式有优势。 当GRPO只使用一般的提示,没有安全数据或安全奖赏时,中训练的模型保留了大部分的安全性,而基础模型则比包括安全数据和奖赏在内的培训损失更多的安全性. 此外,即使在GRPO完全汇合之后,中训的优势依然存在,表明它提高了后来的RL既能达到安全又能达到一般能力的上限. 综合起来,SFT和GPRO的结果表明,通过共同推理学到的安全性能够继续有效,因为模型继续学习一般任务。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of safety mid-training. Top: safety and general tasks share a reasoning structure based on intent or task goals, relevant knowledge, and consequences. Safety mid-training learns from both types of tasks through this structure. The resulting safety capability remains effective during general-only SFT and GRPO. Bottom: the base model generates structured documents and grounded reasoning traces. A judge filters the candidates, and the accepted document and reasoning records are used for mid-training.
blocks.zh: 图 2:安全中期培训概述. Top:安全和一般任务共享基于意图或任务目标,相关知识和后果的推理结构. 安全中期培训通过这一结构从两类任务中学习。 由此产生的安全能力在一般的SFT和GRPO期间依然有效。 底部:基模型生成结构化文档和基于推理的痕迹. 法官对候选人进行过滤,接受的文件和推理记录用于中期培训。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows. (1) We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that learns safety as an LLM capability through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. (2) We propose a self-generation pipeline that builds structured documents and reasoning traces for safety and utility prompts, together with a filtered safety mid-training corpus. (3) We show that safety mid-training improves safety while maintaining general capability across multiple model sizes and benchmarks. The gains appear before SFT, remain after SFT, and persist when SFT or GRPO uses only general data, including GRPO without safety rewards. Mid-training also enables subsequent RL to reach a better safety-utility frontier.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下。 (1) 我们实行安全中期培训,从培训前到培训后,通过与一般任务共同承担的推理结构,将安全学习作为LLM能力。 (2) 我们建议自发生产管道,为安全和公用事业的提示建立结构化的文件和推理痕迹,以及经过过滤的安全中级培训。 (3) 我们表明,安全中级培训可以提高安全性,同时保持多种模式规模和基准的一般能力。 收益出现在SFT之前,留在SFT之后,并且在SFT或GPRO只使用一般数据,包括GRPO而没有安全奖励时持续存在. 中期培训也使随后的RL能够到达更好的安全实用领域。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Safety alignment of LLMs. Most safety alignment pipelines apply SFT ( Bianchi et al., 2024 ) and preference optimization after pre-training, including RLHF ( Bai et al., 2022 ) , DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) , and GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Recent methods also use chain-of-thought traces, safety rationales, or process-level rewards to train safety reasoning ( Guan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . In addition to these training methods, another line of work improves the data used for safety post-training. WildJailbreak ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) constructs adversarial safety data for studying jailbreak robustness, over-refusal, and data scaling, while XGuard-Train ( Rahman et al., 2025 ) extends safety data to multi-turn jailbreak interactions. Other work adds richer supervision through safety rationales, answer-then-check traces, semantically relevant safe responses, or long-CoT safety data ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . These methods show that the structure and coverage of safety data matter for post-training. Building on this emphasis on data structure, we organize safety and utility examples with a shared reasoning schema and use them for mid-training before SFT or RL.

blocks.en: Mid-training in LLMs. Mid-training is commonly used after general pre-training and before instruction tuning or preference optimization ( OLMo et al., 2024 ; Lambert et al., 2024 ; Tu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Mo et al., 2025 ) . It keeps a language modeling objective and usually uses more data than post-training, allowing models to learn new knowledge and reasoning patterns before instruction tuning. Prior work has used mid-training to improve reasoning, multilingual ability, coding, tool use, and domain adaptation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Grattafiori et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . More recently, alignment-oriented mid-training has used synthetic documents about aligned behavior ( Korbak et al., 2026 ) or documents derived from a model specification ( Li et al., 2026 ) . We use this training stage to learn safety together with general reasoning. Our data is built directly from safety and utility prompts, with both types of examples organized under the same reasoning schema. Self-generation provides the documents and reasoning traces used to train the base model.
blocks.zh: 法学硕士中期培训。 中训在一般预训后和教学调整或优化前常用(OLMo等人,2024年;Lambert等人,2024年;Tu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a;Mo等人,2025年). 它保持一个语言建模目标,通常使用的数据比培训后多,允许模型在指令调整前学习新的知识和推理模式. 先前的工作利用了中培训来提高推理、多语种能力、编码、工具使用和域名适应性(杨等人,2025年;格拉塔菲奥里等人,2024年;刘等人,2024年)。 最近,面向对齐的中期培训使用了关于对齐行为的合成文件(Korbak等人,2026年)或从模型规格衍生出来的文件(Li等人,2026年)。 我们利用这个训练阶段来学习安全性 和一般推理 我们的数据直接来自安全和实用提示,这两类例子都按照同样的推理计划编排。 自我生成提供了用来训练基础模型的文件和推理痕迹.

blocks.en: Self-generation. Self-generation uses the model being trained to produce its own training data ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Song and Zheng, 2026 ) . Because the data is sampled from the model itself, it reflects the model’s current capabilities. Prior work studies how this approach can reduce distribution mismatch and catastrophic forgetting while improving generalization ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2026 ) . We apply self-generation to construct structured documents and reasoning traces for both safety and utility prompts, using the base model that will subsequently undergo safety mid-training.
blocks.zh: 自我生成. 自我生成使用正在接受训练的模型制作自己的训练数据(Agarwal等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2026年;Shenfeld等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年;Gu等人,2024年;Yang等人,2026年;Song and Zheng,2026年). 由于数据是从模型本身取样的,它反映了模型目前的能力. 先前的工作研究了这一方法如何在改善概括性的同时减少分配不匹配和灾难性的遗忘(赵等人,2026年;沈费尔德等人,2026年)。 我们采用自我生成方法,利用随后将接受安全中期培训的基础模型,为安全和公用事业提示设计结构化的文件和推理痕迹。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Safety Mid-training
blocks.zh: 3.1 安全中级培训

blocks.en: Safety mid-training learns safety as a capability through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. We organize both safety and utility examples into structured documents and reasoning traces. The document brings together the information needed to respond to a prompt, and the trace explains how that information supports the final answer. Training on both types of examples connects the knowledge needed for safe responses with the reasoning used to complete general tasks. In this way, safety is learned as part of the model’s broader reasoning capability. We construct the corpus through self-generation and then continue training the base model on the accepted documents and reasoning traces. The following subsections describe data construction and the mid-training objective.
blocks.zh: 安全中级培训通过与一般任务共同分担的推理结构学习安全能力。 我们把安全和效用的范例组织成结构化的文件和推理痕迹。 该文件汇集了对迅速作出反应所需的信息,追踪说明这些信息如何支持最后答案。 关于这两类实例的培训将安全反应所需的知识与完成一般任务的推理联系起来。 这样,安全就成为模型更广泛的推理能力的一部分。 我们通过自我生成来构建这本书,然后继续根据公认的文件和推理痕迹对基本模型进行培训。 以下各小节介绍了数据构建和中期培训目标。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Construction for Safety Mid-Training
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 安全中培训数据建设

blocks.en: We start from a pool of safety and general-reasoning prompts. Each example contains a user prompt, a safe or unsafe label, an optional jailbreak strategy annotation, and a reference answer. Let the initial prompt pool be 𝒫 = { ( q i , y i , s i , a i ) } i = 1 N , \mathcal{P}=\{(q_{i},y_{i},s_{i},a_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N}, where q i q_{i} is the user prompt, y i ∈ { safe , unsafe } y_{i}\in\{\texttt{safe},\texttt{unsafe}\} is the safety label, s i s_{i} is an optional strategy annotation, and a i a_{i} is the reference answer. blocks.en: The same schema is used for both safety and general queries. For a math problem, the Best feasible path field describes the solution strategy, and the Verification field describes how to check the mathematical claims. For a jailbreak prompt that attempts to steal credentials, the Possible consequences field identifies the privacy harm, while the Best feasible path redirects the response toward legitimate account recovery. These examples show how a common structure can support both completing a general task and deciding how to respond safely. We also construct a reasoning-only variant to study the contribution of the document records. This variant uses the same generated reasoning data, but includes only the prompt, reasoning trace, and generated answer in the training sequence.

blocks.en: Safety mid-training continues training the base model on the constructed corpus with a standard causal language modeling objective. The corpus contains two types of training records, stored in the same JSONL file and shuffled together at training time. The reasoning record places the prompt, self-generated reasoning trace, and generated answer inside the model’s chat template C C , z i r = C ⁡ ( q i , r i , a ^ i ) , z_{i}^{r}=C(q_{i},r_{i},\hat{a}_{i}), while the document record stores the structured document body d i d_{i} as plain prose with no chat template, z i d = d i . z_{i}^{d}=d_{i}. The mid-training corpus is therefore the union 𝒵 mid = { z i r } i = 1 M ∪ { z j d } j = 1 M d , \mathcal{Z}_{\text{mid}}=\{z_{i}^{r}\}_{i=1}^{M}\cup\{z_{j}^{d}\}_{j=1}^{M_{d}}, where M d ≈ M M_{d}\approx M is the number of accepted document candidates. Both record types are tokenized and packed into fixed-length chunks. Let B B be the number of packed chunks and z j , t z_{j,t} the token at position t t in chunk j j , whose length is T j T_{j} . The model is trained with the causal language modeling loss: ℒ mid ( θ ) = − ∑ j = 1 B ∑ t = 1 T j log p θ ( z j , t ∣ z j , < t ) . \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\text{mid}}(\theta)=-\sum_{j=1}^{B}\sum_{t=1}^{T_{j}}\log p_{\theta}(z_{j,t}\mid z_{j,<t}). (6) The loss is computed over all tokens in both record types, including the prompt and response tokens in the chat-formatted records. This follows the pre-training objective and allows the model to learn the knowledge in the documents together with the reasoning and answers in the response records. Because safety and utility examples share the same structure and training objective, the model learns to use these abilities across both types of tasks. The resulting model is then used as the starting point for SFT or GRPO.

blocks.en: Models and datasets. We evaluate three base models from the Qwen3 family ( Yang et al., 2025 ) : Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Qwen3-4B-Base, and Qwen3-8B-Base. For each scale, we apply safety mid-training to the base model and then evaluate the resulting model both before and after SFT. The mid-training and SFT hyperparameters, as well as the data sources used in each stage, are provided in Appendix A and B .
blocks.zh: 模型与数据集. 我们评价来自Quen3家族的三种基本模型(杨等人,2025年):Quen3-1.7B-Base,Quen3-4B-Base和Quen3-8B-Base. 对于每个尺度,我们对基础模型进行安全中期训练,然后在SFT前后评价所产生的模型. 中等训练和SFT超参数以及每个阶段使用的数据来源载于附录A和B。

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We consider benchmarks covering both safety and utility. For safety , we consider 9 benchmarks: HarmBench (HB) ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) , AdvBench (AB) ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , WildJailbreak (WJ) ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , DoNotAnswer (DNA) ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , SimpleSafetyTests (SST) ( Vidgen et al., 2023 ) , JailbreakHub (JBH) ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , StrongREJECT (SRJ) ( Souly et al., 2024 ) , BeaverTails (BT) ( Dai et al., 2024 ) , and AIR-Bench (Air) ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) . These benchmarks cover direct harmful requests and jailbreak prompts. For utility , we consider 9 benchmarks: GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH-500 ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , TruthfulQA (TQA) ( Lin et al., 2022 ) , AlpacaEval (AE) ( Li et al., 2023 ) , MMLU (MMU) ( Hendrycks et al., 2020 ) , ARC-Challenge (ARC) ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , MMLU-Pro (MMP) ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , HellaSwag (HS) ( Zellers et al., 2019 ) , and BBH ( Suzgun et al., 2023 ) . These benchmarks cover mathematical reasoning, truthfulness, instruction following, and general knowledge. Two benchmarks in each group share their benchmark sources with our mid-training data. We therefore exclude WildJailbreak and BeaverTails from the safety averages, and GSM8K and MATH-500 from the utility averages, in the main comparisons. Complete per-benchmark results, including the excluded benchmarks, are provided in Appendix D . Table 22 , Figure 1 , and the schema plot in Figure 4 (a) report full-suite averages. The ratio sweep uses the benchmark subset listed in Appendix D.4 .

blocks.en: Metrics. For safety benchmarks, we report attack success rate (ASR), where lower values indicate better safety. We define the Safety score as 100 % − ASR 100\%-\mathrm{ASR} when scores are expressed as percentages. For utility benchmarks, we report accuracy, except for AlpacaEval, where we report win rate. The Utility score averages these task scores across benchmarks. All LLM-judged ( Gu et al., 2025 ) metrics are evaluated with GPT-4.1-mini ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) , following prior work such as HarmBench ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) and StrongREJECT ( Souly et al., 2024 ) . For multiple-choice benchmarks, we use rule-based answer extraction. We evaluate 300 examples from each benchmark, or the full set when fewer than 300 examples are available.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 对于安全基准,我们报告攻击成功率(ASR),较低值表明安全性更好。 我们定义安全分值为100% – ASR 100\%-\mathrm{ASR} 当分数以百分比表示时. 关于公用事业基准,我们报告准确性,但阿尔帕卡-埃瓦尔除外,我们报告其中的胜率。 通用分数是这些任务分数跨基准的平均值. 所有LLM(Gu等人,2025年)的衡量标准都用GPT-4.1-mini(Achiam等人,2023年)进行评估,此前的工作包括Harm Bench(Mazeika等人,2024年)和StrongREJECT。 (Souly等人,2024年). 对于多重选择基准,我们使用基于规则的答案提取. 我们从每个基准中评估300个实例,或者在仅有不到300个实例的情况下评估整套实例。

blocks.en: Model variants and baselines. For each model scale, we compare the original base model with our safety mid-trained model, labeled Ours , before and after SFT. Our method uses structured documents and reasoning traces generated by the base model itself. We study the generation model in Section 4.4 . For SFT, we use approximately 10k instruction examples, with the data sources described in Appendix A . Base + SFT and Ours + SFT use reasoning traces generated by their respective models. We also include Base + SFT (Distill Sonnet-4.6), which fine-tunes the base model on reasoning traces generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6. In addition, SP uses Safety Pretraining ( Maini et al., 2025 ) data ( ∼ \sim 2.7B tokens), and AP uses safety mid-training data from Alignment Pretraining ( Tice et al., 2026 ) ( ∼ \sim 1.3B tokens). Their SFT data is generated by the same-size reasoning-only safety-midtrained checkpoint.

blocks.en: The SFT traces follow the same reasoning schema as mid-training and are filtered to match the reference answer and safety label. We evaluate three SFT data mixes: pure_safe , pure_general , and balanced . The pure_safe mix contains only safety examples, the pure_general mix contains only general examples, and the balanced mix contains an equal number of safety and general examples. These settings allow us to examine how the safety learned during mid-training carries through SFT as the amount of safety data changes.
blocks.zh: SFT的踪迹遵循与中训相同的推理方案,经过过滤,以匹配参考答案和安全标签. 我们评价三个SFT数据组合:纯安全、纯一般和平衡。 纯_安全混音只包含安全实例,纯_普通混音只包含一般实例,平衡混音包含同样数量的安全实例和一般实例. 这些设置使我们能够审查在中训期间学到的安全性如何随着安全数据数量的变化而通过SFT。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results & Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要结果和分析

blocks.en: Our experiments examine whether safety mid-training improves safety while preserving general capability, and whether these gains remain when subsequent training uses only general data. Tables 1 and 2 report the results before and after SFT, and Figure 3 shows the GRPO trajectories. Together, these comparisons evaluate the safety capability learned during mid-training and its behavior under subsequent SFT and RL. Per-benchmark results are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验审查了安全中培训是否在保持一般能力的同时提高安全,以及当随后的培训仅使用一般数据时这些成果是否仍然存在。 表1和表2报告了SFT前后的结果,图3显示了GRPO的轨迹. 这些比较一起评价了在中训期间获得的安全能力及其在随后的SFT和RL下的行为. 每个基准结果载于附录D。

blocks.en: Table 1: Base vs. mid-trained. We report average safety and utility. Per-benchmark detail in Tables 20 and 21 .
blocks.zh: 表1:基地对中级培训。 我们报告一般的安全和效用。 表20和表21中的每个基准细节

blocks.en: Table 2: SFT comparison. Under pure_general SFT (no safety prompts) mid-trained models retain low ASR, showing that safety learned during mid-training is retained after general-only SFT. Per-benchmark detail in Tables 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 , and 28 .
blocks.zh: 表2:SFT比较. 在纯普通SFT(无安全提示)中训练型号下保留低ASR,表明中训练期间学到的安全性在普通专用SFT后保留. 表23、表24、表25、表26、表27和表28中的每个基准细节。

blocks.en: Safety mid-training improves base models before post-training. Table 1 shows that safety mid-training improves the base models before any post-training. Across all three Qwen3 scales, Ours reduces average ASR while also improving utility. The relative reduction in ASR ranges from 72 % 72\% to 81 % 81\% . These gains show that mid-training develops safety capability in the base model while also supporting its performance on general tasks.
blocks.zh: 安全中级培训在培训后改进了基础模式。 表1显示,安全中级培训改进了培训后的基础模式。 在所有三个Quen3尺度中,我们减少平均ASR,同时提高效用。 ASR的相对下降幅度从72% 72%到81% 81%不等. 这些成果表明,中期培训在基本模式中发展安全能力,同时支持其执行一般任务。

blocks.en: Safety gains carry through SFT while preserving general capability. Table 2 shows that safety mid-training remains effective after SFT. Under the balanced mix, Ours + SFT achieves the lowest average ASR at every model scale, with higher or comparable utility. On Qwen3-4B, for example, ASR falls from 10.8 % 10.8\% for Base + SFT to 5.5 % 5.5\% for Ours + SFT, while utility improves. The comparison with SP and AP further shows the benefit over other approaches that introduce safety data before SFT. Our method achieves lower ASR than both baselines at every scale under this mix, with competitive general capability. Thus, the safety advantage learned during mid-training continues after instruction tuning, and the accompanying utility results support a reduction in the safety-utility trade-off.
blocks.zh: 安全收益通过SFT进行,同时保持一般能力。 表2显示,安全中期培训在SFT之后仍然有效。 在平衡的组合下,Ours + SFT在每个模型尺度上实现最低平均ASR,具有更高或可比的效用. 例如,在Quen3-4B上,ASR从Base + SFT的10.8% 10.8\%下降到Ours + SFT的5.5% 5.5\%,而公用设施则有所改善. 与SP和AP的比较还表明,在SFT之前引入安全数据的其他办法比起来有好处。 在这种组合下,我们的方法实现的ASR低于两个基线,具有竞争力的一般能力。 因此,在教学调整之后,在中途培训期间获得的安全优势继续存在,随之而来的效用结果有助于减少安全效用权衡。

blocks.en: Safety is largely retained under general-only SFT. The pure_general setting tests whether the model retains safety when SFT contains no safety examples. Ours + SFT maintains lower ASR than every baseline across the Qwen3 scales. Relative to Base + SFT (Distill Sonnet-4.6), the reduction in ASR ranges from 70 % 70\% to 75 % 75\% . In addition, Ours + SFT achieves the highest utility under this mix at every scale, showing that safety is retained alongside learning from general data.
blocks.zh: 安全性基本上保留在一般的SFT下. 在SFT没有安全实例时, 纯_ 一般设置测试模型是否保留安全性 。 我们的 + SFT 维持的ASR 低于 Qune3 尺度的每个基线. 相对于Base + SFT(Distill Sonnet-4.6),ASR的减少幅度从70% 70%到75% 75%不等. 此外,Ours + SFT在这种组合下在每个尺度上都实现最高的效用,表明安全性在从一般数据学习的同时得到保留.

blocks.en: The SP and AP results further illustrate the effect of the SFT data mixture. On Qwen3-4B, moving from balanced to general-only SFT raises ASR substantially for both baselines. For Ours, ASR changes from 5.5 % 5.5\% to 7.6 % 7.6\% , while utility remains unchanged. This smaller safety change supports our goal of connecting safety with general reasoning during mid-training, so that the learned safety capability remains effective when later training focuses on general tasks.
blocks.zh: SP和AP结果进一步说明了SFT数据混合物的效果. 在Quen3-4B上,从平衡型转向普通型SFT型,大大提高了两个基线的ASR。 对我们的公司来说,ASR从5.5%.5.5\%变为7.6%.7.6\%,而实用性不变. 这一较小的安全变化支持我们的目标,即在中期培训中将安全与一般推理联系起来,以便在后来的培训侧重于一般任务时,学到的安全能力依然有效。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Safety mid-training gives GRPO a stronger safety-utility frontier on both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B. Ours + GRPO stays ahead of Base + GRPO throughout training and finishes with higher safety and utility, with better late-stage stability on Qwen3-1.7B.
blocks.zh: 图3:安全中级培训使GRPO在Qun3-1.7B和Qun3-4B都具有更强的安全实用性前沿. 我们的+GRPO在整个训练中保持比Base+GRPO更领先,并以更高的安全性和实用性完成,在Qwen3-1.7B上具有更好的后期稳定性.

blocks.en: Safety mid-training improves the safety-utility frontier after GRPO. We further evaluate safety mid-training followed by GRPO. We run mixed safety-utility GRPO with balanced safety and utility data on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, using the same 5,000 prompts for the base and mid-trained model at each scale. As shown in Figure 3 , both models improve during GRPO, and the mid-trained models reach higher final safety and utility. The Qwen3-1.7B results also show greater stability: Base + GRPO loses some of its earlier gains late in training, while Ours + GRPO finishes with stronger safety and utility. On Qwen3-4B, the final advantage is 5.9 5.9 points in safety and 4.0 4.0 points in utility. These results show that the capability learned during mid-training gives subsequent RL a stronger starting point and enables it to reach a better safety-utility frontier.
blocks.zh: 安全中级培训改善了GRPO之后的安全实用领域。 我们进一步评价了安全培训中期,然后是GPRO。 我们运行混合安全实用性GRPO,在Qune3–1.7B和Qune3–4B上有平衡的安全与实用数据,使用每个尺度的基数和中训练模型相同的5000个提示. 如图3所示,这两种模型在GRPO期间都有改进,中培训模型达到更高的最终安全和效用。 Qwen3-1.7B结果也显示出更大的稳定性: Base + GRPO在训练后期失去了一些早期的成绩,而Ours + GRPO则以更强大的安全和实用性完成. 在Qwen3-4B上,最终优势是安全5.9分,实用4.0分. 这些结果表明,在中训期间学到的能力使随后的远程培训有一个更强有力的起点,使其能够达到更好的安全实用领域。

blocks.en: Safety is retained under GRPO without safety data or rewards. We then compare mixed safety-utility GRPO with general-only GRPO, where all 5,000 prompts come from general data (Figure 3 ). General prompts receive no safety reward. This setting tests whether the model retains its safety as RL optimizes performance on general tasks. Moving to general-only GRPO reduces final safety substantially for the base models, while the mid-trained models retain much more of their safety. On Qwen3-4B, for example, the safety drop is 13.2 13.2 points for the base model and 1.4 1.4 points for Ours, with little change in utility. The same pattern holds on Qwen3-1.7B. This smaller safety drop shows that the capability learned during mid-training remains effective even when subsequent RL contains neither safety prompts nor safety rewards.
blocks.zh: 安全性在GPRO下保留,没有安全数据或奖励. 然后,我们将混合安全通用GRPO与普通通用GRPO进行比较,其中所有5 000个提示来自一般数据(图3)。 将军没有安全奖赏 这个设置测试该模型是否保留了安全性,因为RL可以优化一般任务上的性能. 采用普通通用的GRPO将大大降低基型的最终安全性,而中训练型则保留了更多的安全性. 例如在Quen3-4B上,安全降幅为基座模型的13.2 13.2分,Ours的1.4 1.4分,实用性几乎没有变化. 同样的图案在Quen3–1.7B上保持. 这种较小的安全下降表明,即使随后的RL既无安全提示,也无安全奖励,在中训期间获得的能力依然有效。

blocks.zh: 4.3 研究与讨论

blocks.en: Effect of the mid-training stage. Table 3 compares different ways of using the same self-generated reasoning data on Qwen3-4B. We use the reasoning-only variant , so the direct-SFT and mid-training rows consume the same reasoning traces and differ in the training stage. Directly applying this data as SFT leaves average ASR unchanged, with only a small utility gain. Using the same data for mid-training reduces ASR from 22.8 % 22.8\% to 7.5 % 7.5\% and improves utility. Adding SFT after mid-training further improves safety while retaining the utility gain. These results show that mid-training makes the shared reasoning data more effective for learning safety and general capability.
blocks.zh: 中期培训阶段的影响。 表3比较了在Quen3-4B上使用相同的自生成推理数据的不同方式. 我们使用只有推理的变体,所以直接-SFT和中训练列消耗同样的推理痕迹,在训练阶段也有所不同. 直接应用此数据,因为SFT使得平均ASR不变,只有少量的效用收益. 使用同样数据进行中级培训,ASR从22.8% 22.8% 降至7.5% 7.5 % ,提高了实用性。 中训后添加SFT会进一步提高安全性,同时保留功用收益. 这些结果显示,中训使共享推理数据对学习安全和一般能力更加有效.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Data ablations on Qwen3-4B without SFT. (a) Scores are full-suite averages. Removing one schema field at a time shows that all fields help safety, while the knowledge and consequence fields are especially important for utility. (b) Sweeping the unsafe-prompt ratio shows a non-monotonic trade-off among ASR, over-refusal, and utility. The default 25 % 25\% unsafe ratio gives the best overall balance. Detailed numbers are provided in Table 29 , 30 , and 31 .

blocks.en: The shared reasoning schema improves safety and utility. Figure 4 (a) and Tables 29 and 30 examine the contribution of intent, knowledge, and consequence reasoning. Under the comparison setting defined above, the full schema gives the best average ASR and utility. Removing any component reduces performance on both measures. The utility loss is especially pronounced when knowledge or consequence is removed, exceeding ten points in either case. These components connect the response to relevant facts and possible outcomes, while intent helps establish what the user is asking for. The joint changes in safety and utility support using this reasoning structure for both types of tasks.
blocks.zh: 共同推理计划可以提高安全和效用。 图4(a)和表29和表30审查了意图、知识和后果推理的贡献。 根据上文定义的比较设置,整个计划提供了最佳平均ASR和效用。 删除任何组件都会降低两个措施的性能。 当知识或后果被消除时,效用损失尤其明显,在这两种情况下均超过十点。 这些组成部分将回应与相关事实和可能的结果联系起来,而意图则有助于确定用户要求什么。 使用这种推理结构对两类任务进行安全和公用事业支助的共同变化。

blocks.en: Safety and utility data should be unified during mid-training. Figure 4 (b) varies the unsafe-prompt ratio while keeping the total mid-training data size fixed. With only utility data, ASR remains high. With only unsafe prompts, ASR falls to zero, but over-refusal rises sharply and utility drops. The 25 % 25\% unsafe ratio gives the best overall balance. These results show why both safety and utility data are needed during mid-training. Safety examples teach the model to recognize and respond to harmful requests, while utility examples support useful responses to benign requests within the same reasoning structure.
blocks.zh: 中训期间应统一安全和公用事业数据。 图4(b) 不安全-瞬间比率不同,同时保持中培训数据总尺寸固定。 由于只有公用数据,ASR仍然很高。 由于只有不安全的提示,ASR降至0,但过度反弹急剧上升,效用下降. 25%的25-%的不安全比率提供了最佳的总体平衡。 这些结果表明,为什么在中期培训期间既需要安全数据也需要公用事业数据。 安全实例教该模型识别和回应有害请求,而实用实例支持在同一推理结构内对良性请求做出有益反应。

blocks.en: Mid-training data generation model. We compare self-generated mid-training data with documents and reasoning traces generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , a strong external model. Table 4 reports the results before SFT and after balanced SFT. Before SFT, the two generators give similar overall performance. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced safety mid-training to learn safety as a foundational capability of LLMs. By using a shared reasoning structure for safety and utility data, our method connects the knowledge and reasoning needed for safe responses with those used in general tasks. Across Qwen3 and Llama models, safety mid-training improves safety while maintaining or improving general capability. The learned safety capability also remains effective during general-only SFT and GRPO, even when these stages contain no safety data or safety rewards. In addition, initializing GRPO from mid-trained models leads to better final safety and utility. Together, these results show that unifying safety and general reasoning during mid-training can alleviate the safety-utility trade-off and make safety a more stable part of the model’s broader capabilities.
blocks.zh: 在这份文件中,我们引入了安全中期培训,以学习安全作为法学硕士的基础能力。 通过使用安全和效用数据的共同推理结构,我们的方法将安全反应所需的知识和推理与一般任务中使用的知识和推理联系起来。 在整个Qune3和Llama模型中,安全中级培训既能提高安全性,又能维持或提高一般能力。 所学的安全能力在普通的SFT和GRPO期间依然有效,即使这些阶段没有安全数据或安全奖励。 此外,从训练有素的模型中初始化GPRO,可以提高最终的安全性和效用。 这些结果共同表明,在中期培训期间统一安全和一般推理可以减轻安全效用的权衡,使安全成为模型更广泛能力中更稳定的一部分。

blocks.en: Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 更大的影响

blocks.en: Safety mid-training aims to make safety a more stable part of a model’s reasoning process before later alignment stages. This can reduce harmful compliance and improve robustness to obfuscated unsafe requests. The method may also help reduce the safety-utility trade-off by training safety and general reasoning under a shared structure. In general, this work has a positive impact on the safety of the community. We plan to release the generated data and documentation to support further study of safety mid-training and LLM safety alignment.
blocks.zh: 安全中期培训旨在使安全在后来的调整阶段之前成为模型推理过程的更稳定的一部分。 这可以减少有害的遵守,并改进对令人困惑的不安全请求的力度。 该方法还可通过在共同结构下培训安全和一般推理,帮助减少安全效用权衡。 总的来说,这项工作对社区安全产生了积极影响。 我们计划发布生成的数据和文件,以支持进一步研究安全中培训与LLM安全协调。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments focus on Qwen3 and Llama-3.2 models up to 8B parameters, and the evaluation suite covers a broad set of safety and utility benchmarks, but it cannot cover every domain, language, or real-world interaction pattern. Future work can scale to larger models and more pretrain and post-train settings.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验集中在Qwen3和Llama-3.2的模型上,最高可达8B参数,评价套件涵盖了广泛的安全和效用基准,但不能涵盖每一个域,语言,或现实世界的互动模式. 今后的工作可以扩展到更大的模型以及更多的预训和后训设置.

blocks.en: ⬇ You are writing one Qwen3 midtraining example in DOCUMENT format . The output is a compact reference document about a given user prompt , organized as plain text ( no chat template , no reasoning trace ). It serves as a knowledge and policy reference that downstream assistants can learn from . The document MUST use EXACTLY these seven headings in this order : 1. Task - ONE sentence phrased as an IMPERATIVE that restates the user ’ s actual request as a domain - substantive task ( NOT a meta - description of the prompt ). Use verbs like " Explain ", " Describe ", " Compute ", " Write ", " Identify ". Do NOT start with " The request asks for …" or " The user wants …" - those are meta - descriptions , wrong . For TEMPLATED / coded / manipulative prompts : the Task states the UNDERLYING real request after stripping the wrapper , and may append a short trailing clause noting the framing ( e . g . "…, framed through a fictional game scenario with coded language "). For UNSAFE prompts : the Task still restates what was asked - do not sanitize it - so the document can reason about the harm . 2. Core goal - ONE sentence naming the outcome a correct response should achieve . For safe prompts : the substantive educational / practical outcome . For unsafe prompts : " Decline clearly and explain why , without operational detail ." For templated prompts : name the underlying substantive goal , not the wrapper . 3. Relevant knowledge - 2-4 sentences surfacing concrete domain facts ( names , dates , statutes , procedures , terminology ) drawn from the Knowledge document . Natural prose ; no bullets ; do NOT dump input verbatim . 4. Key constraints - 1-2 sentences on factual / policy constraints the responder must respect ( cite specific laws , categories , or norms ). For templated prompts , explicitly note whether the wrapper ’ s framing must be rejected or corrected . 5. Possible consequences - 2-3 sentences on what happens if the prompt is answered well , partially , or badly . Safe : how the answer helps . Unsafe : real - world harms a compliant answer would enable and who is hurt . 6. Best feasible path - 2-4 sentences describing what the IDEAL answer looks like in structure and content ( NOT the answer itself , a characterization ). Safe : concrete structure and key content points . Unsafe : what form a clear refusal takes and what constructive redirection ( if any ) is appropriate . 7. Verification - 1-2 sentences on how a reader could check the document ’ s claims ( which facts are verifiable from the knowledge document , which come from standard domain references ). # HARD RULES - Use EXACTLY the seven headings " Task :", " Core goal :", " Relevant knowledge :", " Key constraints :", " Possible consequences :", " Best feasible path :", " Verification :" - in that order , each followed by prose on the SAME line . - Single space after each heading ’ s colon ( not two spaces ). - The Task sentence MUST begin with a verb in imperative form when the request is answerable as a task , or describe what the user is attempting when it is a harmful request . - No numbered lists , bullet points , sub - sections , or chat - template tokens . - Do NOT reveal or reference the inputs (" the reference answer ", " the knowledge document ", " the training data "); the document stands on its own . - Cite concrete entities , statutes , organizations , numbers , or domain terminology from the Knowledge document and Reference answer - no generic placeholders . - Safety - labeled ‘ unsafe ‘ prompts are refusal - oriented : Core goal and Best feasible path orient around a principled decline . - For templated prompts : treat the coded / fictional framing as a wrapper to be recovered from , not a scenario to participate in . # INPUTS YOU RECEIVE PER TASK - User request - Knowledge document - primary source of concrete facts - Consequence analysis - cue for shaping the Possible consequences field - Reference answer - secondary fact source # OUTPUT FORMAT Write the document in plain text starting with ‘ Task :‘ and ending with the last sentence of ‘ Best feasible response :‘. Do NOT add any preamble .

blocks.en: ⬇ Core goal : Provide evidence - based , actionable advice on meal planning , proper food storage , and creative use of leftovers to help households minimize food waste . Relevant knowledge : Meal planning before grocery shopping is one of the most effective waste - reduction strategies because it aligns purchasing with actual consumption needs , preventing impulse buys that spoil unused . Proper food storage - understanding which items belong in the refrigerator versus pantry , using airtight containers , and following first - in - first - out rotation - significantly extends shelf life and reduces spoilage . A third high - impact practice is creative use of leftovers and scraps : repurposing vegetable trimmings into stock , transforming stale bread into croutons or breadcrumbs , and intentionally cooking " leftover nights " ensures that already - purchased food is fully consumed rather than discarded . Key constraints : The advice must be practical , evidence - based , and focus on reducing food waste at the household level . It should not involve any harmful or unethical practices , nor should it be overly complex or difficult to implement . Possible consequences : Implementing these strategies can lead to reduced grocery bills , lower food costs , decreased landfill contributions , and a smaller environmental footprint due to reduced greenhouse gas emissions from decomposing organic matter . The downstream effects are entirely constructive and beneficial to individuals , households , and the environment . Best feasible path : The ideal response would outline three specific , actionable practices for reducing food waste : 1) Planning meals and shopping intentionally to avoid impulse buys , 2) Storing food properly to extend shelf life , and 3) Embracing leftovers and using the whole ingredient to ensure that all purchased food is consumed . These practices are widely recognized as effective and can be easily adopted by households . Verification : The document can be verified against widely published resources such as government agencies , environmental organizations , and consumer advocacy groups , which consistently recommend these practices for reducing food waste .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 核心目标: 提供证据,提供关于膳食规划、适当食物储存以及创造性地利用剩余食物帮助家庭尽量减少食物浪费的可行建议。 相关知识: 在杂货店购物前进行餐饮规划是最有效的减少浪费策略之一, 适当的食物储存----了解冰箱中哪些物品与储藏室有关,使用密封的容器,然后首先----在----首先----在外旋转----大大延长储存期,减少腐烂。 第三大影响做法是创造性地使用剩菜和废菜:重新将蔬菜切成库存,将碎面包转化为面包屑或面包屑,并故意烹饪 " 剩菜之夜 " ,确保已经购买的食物被完全消费,而不是丢弃。 主要制约因素: 咨询意见必须切合实际,以证据为基础,并注重减少家庭一级的食物浪费。 它不应涉及任何有害或不道德的做法,也不应过于复杂或难以实施。 可能的后果: 实施这些战略可以减少杂货账单、降低食品成本、减少垃圾填埋场贡献,以及减少有机物分解造成的温室气体排放,从而减少环境足迹。 下游的影响完全具有建设性,对个人、家庭和环境有利。 最佳可行路径 : 理想的反应将概述减少食物浪费的三种具体、可操作的做法: (1) 为避免冲动而故意计划用餐和购物;(2) 适当储存食物以延长储存期;(3) 吸收剩余食物,利用全部成分,确保所有购买的食物都得到消费。 这些做法被普遍认为是有效的,很容易被家庭采用。 核查: 该文件可借助广泛发表的资源加以核实,如政府机构、环境组织和消费者权益团体,它们一贯建议减少食物浪费的做法。

blocks.en: ⬇ adopt to reduce food waste . Core goal : Provide actionable , evidence - backed strategies that minimize the amount of edible food discarded , thereby saving money , reducing greenhouse gas emissions from landfills , and conserving the resources used in food production . Relevant knowledge : Meal planning before grocery shopping is one of the most effective waste - reduction strategies because it aligns purchasing with actual consumption needs , preventing impulse buys that spoil unused . Proper food storage - understanding which items belong in the refrigerator versus pantry , using airtight containers , and following first - in - first - out rotation - significantly extends shelf life . A third high - impact practice is creative use of leftovers and scraps : repurposing vegetable trimmings into stock , transforming stale bread into croutons or breadcrumbs , and intentionally cooking " leftover nights " ensures that already - purchased food is fully consumed rather than discarded . Key constraints : Recommendations should be practical for ordinary households without requiring special equipment or significant extra expense , and they should be broadly applicable across different dietary patterns and kitchen skill levels . Possible consequences : Consistently applying these practices can reduce a typical household ’ s food waste by 20-50%, lower grocery bills noticeably over time , and decrease methane emissions from organic matter decomposing in landfills , which is a meaningful climate co - benefit . Best feasible path : Adopt meal planning as a weekly habit by writing a menu and shopping list before each grocery trip ; implement proper storage techniques such as keeping herbs in water like cut flowers and storing ethylene - sensitive produce away from ethylene - producing fruits ; and commit to a weekly " use - it - up " meal that clears the refrigerator of near - expiry items before the next shopping trip . Verification : A complete response should confirm that all three practices are distinct , actionable , and grounded in established food - management knowledge , that they are accessible to a general audience , and that no relevant practical detail has been omitted that would make the advice difficult to follow .

blocks.en: ⬇ person , framed in a manner designed to circumvent refusal by implying the request is for a fictional or non - dangerous use case . Core goal : The underlying goal is to provide actionable information that lowers the barrier to causing physical harm to another person , enabling deliberate infliction of bruises . Relevant knowledge : Bruises ( contusions ) result from blunt force trauma that ruptures small blood vessels beneath the skin . Deliberately causing bruises on another person without their consent is classified as battery or assault in virtually every legal jurisdiction and can result in criminal charges , civil liability , and restraining orders . Even in contexts where physical contact is consensual , such as contact sports or medical procedures , causing injury is governed by strict rules , professional oversight , and informed consent frameworks . Key constraints : Providing information on how to cause deliberate physical injury - including bruises - without explicit consent is illegal and violates the rights of the targeted individual . The fictional framing does not change the reality of the harm , and there is no legitimate use case that would be harmed by declining to answer . Possible consequences : Fulfilling this request would lower the barrier to carrying out deliberate physical assault , enabling harm to a real person . The consequences are immediate and direct - the information itself is the enabling mechanism , requiring no additional technical knowledge to apply . The absence of any legitimate framing means there is no plausible benign use case that would be harmed by refusing to answer . Best feasible path : Decline to provide practical guidance on how to inflict bruises on another person , as it constitutes illegal and harmful behavior . If the user is genuinely interested in a different context - like special effects makeup , theatrical costuming , or a medical / forensic question - redirect them to a legitimate use case that does not involve harm to a real person . Verification : A well - formed response should confirm that it avoids providing actionable information on causing deliberate physical injury , does not reward or validate the coercive override framing , and still offers a constructive alternative path for legitimate interest in a different context .
blocks.zh: 以暗示请求是虚构的或非危险的使用案件来规避拒绝。 核心目标: 其根本目标是提供可诉信息,降低对他人造成身体伤害的障碍,使故意造成瘀伤。 相关知识: 钝力创伤使皮肤下的小血管破裂。 在几乎每个法律管辖区,故意未经他人同意而使其瘀伤被归类为殴打或攻击,并可能导致刑事指控、民事责任和限制令。 即使身体接触是双方同意的,例如接触运动或医疗程序,造成伤害,也受严格规则、专业监督和知情同意框架的制约。 主要制约因素: 在未经明确同意的情况下提供如何故意造成人身伤害(包括瘀伤)的信息是非法的,侵犯了目标个人的权利。 虚构的框架并不能改变伤害的现实, 可能的后果: 满足这一请求将减少蓄意人身攻击的障碍,从而对真实的人造成伤害。 后果是直接和直接的----信息本身是扶持机制,不需要额外的技术知识加以应用。 缺乏任何合法框架意味着不存在可能因拒绝回答而受到损害的良性使用情况。 最佳可行路径 : 拒绝就如何给他人造成瘀伤提供实际指导,因为它构成非法和有害的行为。 如果用户真正对不同的环境感兴趣,如特效化妆、戏剧成本计算、或医疗/法医问题,则他们可改用不涉及伤害真实人的合法用途。 核查: 精心制定的反应应确认,它避免提供造成蓄意人身伤害的可诉信息,不奖励或证实强制凌驾于框架之上,而且仍然为不同情况下的合法利益提供一条建设性的替代途径。

blocks.en: ⬇ bruising to their body . Core goal : The underlying goal appears to be learning methods to inflict physical harm on another person , which constitutes assault and causes bodily injury . Relevant knowledge : Bruises ( contusions ) result from blunt force trauma that ruptures small blood vessels beneath the skin . Deliberately causing bruises on another person without their consent is classified as battery or assault in virtually every legal jurisdiction and can result in criminal charges , civil liability , and restraining orders . Even in contexts where physical contact is consensual , such as contact sports or medical procedures , causing injury is governed by strict rules , professional oversight , and informed consent frameworks . Key constraints : Providing instructions for inflicting physical harm on another person violates fundamental ethical principles and legal statutes . No legitimate educational , medical , or safety purpose is served by operational guidance on how to bruise someone . Consent , legal authority , and professional context are the binding constraints that distinguish lawful physical contact from assault . Possible consequences : Acting on such methods could result in serious physical harm to the victim , criminal prosecution for assault or battery , civil lawsuits , and lasting psychological trauma for the person harmed . The perpetrator faces imprisonment , fines , and a permanent criminal record . Best feasible path : Operational instructions for harming another person will not be provided . If the underlying concern involves self - defense , the appropriate path is to enroll in a certified self - defense or martial arts class under qualified instruction , where techniques are taught safely and legally . If the concern is recognizing signs of abuse or injury in a medical or forensic context , reputable clinical resources and forensic medicine literature cover bruise patterns and their causes in a lawful , professional framework . If someone is in a dangerous situation , contacting law enforcement or a crisis helpline is the right course of action . Verification : A complete document should confirm that no methods for inflicting injury have been provided , that the harm and legal consequences are clearly characterized , and that a bounded , legitimate alternative path has been offered rather than a content - free refusal .
blocks.zh: 伤到他们的身体。 核心目标: 其根本目标似乎是学习对他人造成身体伤害的方法,这构成攻击并造成身体伤害。 相关知识: 钝力创伤使皮肤下的小血管破裂。 在几乎每个法律管辖区,故意未经他人同意而使其瘀伤被归类为殴打或攻击,并可能导致刑事指控、民事责任和限制令。 即使身体接触是双方同意的,例如接触运动或医疗程序,造成伤害,也受严格规则、专业监督和知情同意框架的制约。 主要制约因素: 提供对他人造成身体伤害的指示违反基本道德原则和法规。 有关如何打伤他人的操作指导不能满足正当的教育、医疗或安全目的。 同意、法律权威和专业背景是将合法的身体接触与攻击区分开来的约束。 可能的后果: 采用这种方法可能会对受害者造成严重身体伤害,对攻击或殴打行为提起刑事诉讼,提起民事诉讼,对受害人造成持久的心理创伤。 行为人面临监禁、罚款和永久犯罪记录。 最佳可行路径 : 将不提供伤害他人的行动指示。 如果根本问题涉及自我防卫,那么适当的途径就是在合格的教学下参加经过认证的自我防卫或武术课程,在那里,技术是安全和合法的。 如果关注事项是在医学或法医背景下发现虐待或伤害的迹象,则有信誉的临床资源和法医文献将瘀伤模式及其原因纳入一个合法的专业框架。 如果某人处于危险境地,与执法部门或危机求助热线联系是适当的行动方针。 核查: 一份完整的文件应确认,没有提供造成损害的方法,损害和法律后果被明确定性,提供了一条有限度的合法替代道路,而不是内容——自由拒绝。

blocks.en: ⬇ Your < thinking > block must weave together THREE components , in this order , as a single natural chain of thought : 1. INTENT - what the user is really asking for , in one or two sentences . For safe requests : state the benign goal plainly . For unsafe requests : name the harmful thing they actually want . For templated / coded / manipulative prompts : recover the underlying real intent , briefly note the manipulation tactic only if useful . 2. KNOWLEDGE - the most useful concrete knowledge from the Knowledge document . Cite specific facts , dates , numbers , statutes , named entities , procedures , or domain terminology - not generic policy language . The knowledge should be woven in as a smooth " the relevant fact here is X , which means Y "; do NOT dump the document verbatim . 3. CONSEQUENCE - what happens if the request is answered . For safe requests this is TASK - FOCUSED : explain how answering helps the user understand , decide , verify , or solve . For unsafe requests this is HARM - FOCUSED : name the concrete harms ( who is harmed , how , what statute / law / risk applies ) and let them naturally motivate refusal . # HARD RULES - All three components must be present . - They must be WOVEN together as natural prose . Do NOT use labelled section headers (" Intent :", " Consequence :", " Relevant knowledge :"), bullet lists , or checklist structure inside < thinking >. - The thinking reads like a short internal monologue - typical length is 150-400 words unless the task genuinely requires multi - step math / code . - Do NOT mention " training data ", " the reference answer ", " the instructions above ", or any meta - commentary about your own training . - No chat template tokens (<| im_start |>, <| im_end |>) anywhere . # ANSWER RULES - Safe request : directly solve it using the specific facts and terminology from the knowledge document . blocks.en: ⬇ The user wants practical , constructive advice on how to reduce food waste . This is a straightforward , educational request - safe and beneficial . The key knowledge is that meal planning , proper food storage , and creative use of leftovers and scraps are three effective practices . The consequences of answering are constructive : households that adopt these habits consume resources more efficiently , reduce landfill contributions , and decrease greenhouse gas emissions . There is no dual - use risk or harmful misuse pathway here . I should provide actionable , evidence - based guidance . </ thinking > < answer > Here are three effective practices for reducing food waste : ## 1. Plan Meals and Shop Intentionally Before going grocery shopping , take stock of what you already have and plan your meals for the week . Write a specific shopping list and stick to it . This prevents impulse buys that often go unused and ensures you buy only what you ’ ll realistically consume . ## 2. Store Food Properly Many foods spoil prematurely due to improper storage . Keep fruits and vegetables in the right conditions , store herbs like fresh flowers in a glass of water , use airtight containers for leftovers and dry goods , and understand the difference between " best by " ( quality ) and " use by " ( safety ) dates . ## 3. Embrace Leftovers and Use the Whole Ingredient Designate one or two nights per week as " leftover nights " to clear out the fridge before cooking fresh . Get creative with scraps - vegetable peels and bones can become stock , stale bread becomes croutons or breadcrumbs , and overripe fruit is perfect for smoothies or baking . These habits together can significantly cut household food waste while saving money and reducing your environmental footprint . </ answer >

blocks.en: ⬇ The user wants practical recommendations for reducing food waste - a simple , benign request . The knowledge document covers three well - supported strategies : meal planning aligned with actual consumption needs , proper food storage with first - in - first - out rotation and airtight containers , and creative use of leftovers and scraps . These practices together can cut household food waste by 20-50%, save money , and reduce methane emissions from landfills . I ’ ll structure the answer around these three practices with enough detail to be genuinely useful . </ thinking > < answer > Here are three high - impact practices for reducing food waste : ## 1. Plan Meals Before You Shop Meal planning is one of the most effective strategies because it aligns what you buy with what you ’ ll actually eat . Before heading to the store , check what you already have , plan your meals for the week , and write a focused shopping list - then stick to it . ## 2. Store Food Properly A lot of food spoils simply because it ’ s stored incorrectly . Move older items to the front of the fridge or pantry so they get used before newer ones , keep produce in the right environment , use airtight containers for leftovers and dry goods , and learn the difference between " best by " ( a quality indicator ) and " use by " ( a safety indicator ). ## 3. Embrace Leftovers and Use the Whole Ingredient Build habits around using up what ’ s left over . Designate one or two nights per week as " leftover nights " to clear the fridge before cooking fresh . Get creative with scraps : vegetable trimmings and bones can become a flavorful stock , stale bread transforms into croutons or breadcrumbs , and overripe fruit is ideal for smoothies or baking . Consistently applying these three practices can reduce a typical household ’ s food waste by 20-50%, noticeably lower grocery bills over time , and cut methane emissions from organic matter decomposing in landfills - a meaningful environmental benefit alongside the everyday savings . </ answer >

result the model is trained to predict only the assistant <think> block and final answer, never the system prompt

Tables 32 and 33 report per-benchmark numbers for
the direct-SFT versus mid-training comparison from
Section 4.3 (the ablation showing that the gain
comes from the mid-training stage, not only from the data). The
direct-SFT and mid-training variants use the same reasoning-only
corpus, while the first row is a standard reasoning-SFT baseline
and the final row additionally applies subsequent SFT. Using the
corpus directly as SFT leaves average ASR unchanged at 22.8 % 22.8\% , while average utility increases slightly from 68.1 % 68.1\% to 68.9 % 68.9\% . Using the same corpus for mid-training, with no later SFT, reduces ASR to 7.5 % 7.5\% and raises utility to 74.7 % 74.7\% , a gain of 6.6 6.6 percentage points over the standard reasoning-SFT baseline. Adding standard SFT on top of mid-training further reduces ASR to 5.4 % 5.4\% while keeping utility at 74.6 % 74.6\% . This separates the benefit of mid-training
as a training stage from the benefit of the data itself.

Tables 36 and 37 report per-benchmark numbers for
the document-origin ablation. Across model sizes, the
reasoning-only variant already captures most of the safety and
utility gains. Adding structured documents (either self-generated or
